list.name: bot
list.label: Bot
list.query: SELECT bot_id FROM bot_state ORDER BY bot_id

targets.rawSql: SELECT state FROM bot_state WHERE bot_id = '$bot'

SELECT CASE WHEN paper_clock_started_at IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE GREATEST(0, FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - paper_clock_started_at)) / 86400)::int) END AS paper_clock_day FROM bot_state WHERE bot_id = '$bot'
SELECT ROUND(promotion_score::numeric, 4) FROM bot_state WHERE bot_id = '$bot'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trades WHERE bot_id = '$bot' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='open' AND COALESCE(sim_metadata->>'strategy','') NOT LIKE 'conviction%'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trades WHERE bot_id = '$bot' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='closed' AND COALESCE(sim_metadata->>'strategy','') NOT LIKE 'conviction%'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM halts WHERE bot_id = '$bot' AND halted_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'

SELECT exit_at AS time, SUM(pnl_usd) OVER (ORDER BY exit_at) AS pnl_cum FROM trades WHERE bot_id = '$bot' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='closed' AND exit_at IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(sim_metadata->>'strategy','') NOT LIKE 'conviction%' ORDER BY exit_at

SELECT exit_at AS time, pnl_pct AS value FROM trades WHERE bot_id = '$bot' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='closed' AND exit_at IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(sim_metadata->>'strategy','') NOT LIKE 'conviction%' ORDER BY exit_at

SELECT computed_at AS time, return_score AS "return", risk_score AS risk, confidence_score AS confidence, regime_score AS regime, calibration_score AS calibration, promotion_score AS promotion FROM scores WHERE bot_id = '$bot' ORDER BY computed_at
SELECT signal_type, COUNT(*) AS count FROM signals WHERE bot_id = '$bot' AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT id, asset, venue, direction, entry_price, size_usd, leverage, entry_at, sim_metadata->>'cluster_size' AS cluster_size, sim_metadata->>'slippage_bps' AS slippage_bps FROM trades WHERE bot_id = '$bot' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='open' AND COALESCE(sim_metadata->>'strategy','') NOT LIKE 'conviction%' ORDER BY entry_at DESC

SELECT id, asset, direction, entry_price, exit_price, size_usd, leverage, ROUND(pnl_pct::numeric, 2) AS pnl_pct, ROUND(pnl_usd::numeric, 2) AS pnl_usd, exit_reason, entry_at, exit_at FROM trades WHERE bot_id = '$bot' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='closed' AND COALESCE(sim_metadata->>'strategy','') NOT LIKE 'conviction%' ORDER BY exit_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 50
SELECT halted_at, halt_type, severity, LEFT(reason, 100) AS reason, resumed_at, resumed_by FROM halts WHERE bot_id = '$bot' AND halted_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days' ORDER BY halted_at DESC
